definitions.explanation: The intensity of light emitted or reflected from a surface, measured per unit area. A technical term used in physics and optics, but also commonly encountered in everyday settings when adjusting screen or display brightness.

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}の{輝度|きど}を{調整|ちょうせい}する。
{輝度|きど}が{高|たか}すぎて{目|め}が{疲|つか}れる。
examples.english: The brightness is too high and it's tiring my eyes.

examples.japanese: このモニターは{最大|さいだい}{輝度|きど}が1000ニトで、{屋外|おくがい}でも{見|み}やすい。
examples.english: This monitor has a maximum brightness of 1000 nits, making it easy to see even outdoors.

notes:
While technically a physics term (luminance, measured in candela per square meter or nits), {輝度|きど} is commonly encountered in everyday contexts when adjusting screens, monitors, and displays. The more casual term {明|あか}るさ (brightness) is used in general conversation, while {輝度|きど} appears in settings menus and technical specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輝度|きど}を{調整|ちょうせい}する: to adjust brightness
- {輝度|きど}を{上|あ}げる/{下|さ}げる: to increase/decrease brightness
- {最大|さいだい}{輝度|きど}: maximum brightness
- {高|こう}{輝度|きど}: high brightness
- {輝度|きど}{設定|せってい}: brightness settings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {明|あか}るさ: brightness — everyday, non-technical word
- {照度|しょうど}: illuminance — measures light falling on a surface (lux), not emitted from it
- {光度|こうど}: luminous intensity — measures total light output of a source in a given direction
